recentEvents.message: fusion policy: agents never switch git branches autonomously (prevents branch-drift chaos). If this task genuinely needs a different branch, STOP and ask the user. The user can deliberately allow it by setting FUSION_ALLOW_BRANCH_SWITCH=1 (or FUSION_ALLOW_WORKTREE=1 for worktrees) in the session env.
